name: Gradescope
target_customers: universities and colleges (instructors, TAs, administrators); some schools

handwritten_reading.evidence: Handwriting recognition (OCR + AI) used to group similar short answers on fixed-template paper work; humans grade the groups

subjective_ai_marking.evidence: AI-assisted answer grouping forms suggested groups of short-answer and multiple-choice questions for review; instructor applies the marks. Institutional plan only

stem_maths.evidence: Paper-based work 'including handwritten answers and diagrams' graded on screen by staff; no AI marking of maths working documented

rubric_marking_scheme.evidence: Dynamic rubrics built in advance or on the fly; import rubrics and rubric item groups on Institutional plan

partial_marks_feedback.evidence: Rubric items give detailed feedback with one click; rubric changes apply retroactively

typed_answers.evidence: Institutional plan covers all assignment types including online and programming; graded by staff

bulk_scan_ingest.evidence: Bulk scanning for instructor-uploaded paper assessments; students can also upload via mobile app

annotated_copy.evidence: Annotation tools on submissions; graded work sent back to students

teacher_review.evidence: Staff grade every question; AI only suggests answer groups for review

question_paper_import.evidence: Not documented on pages opened (help centre blocked automated access)

public_api.evidence: No public grading API found; LTI 1.3 LMS integration documented

integrity_checks.evidence: Code Similarity for programming assignments (Institutional only); no plagiarism/AI-writing check on written answers documented

scale.funding_or_owner_notes: Owned by Turnitin, LLC. Pricing page lists Basic (free) and Institutional (contact sales).

name: Crowdmark
